newsitem.title: UK: Granada rises ahead of figures next week.
newsitem.headline: Granada rises ahead of figures next week.

text.p: Shares in media and leisure group Granada Group Plc rose on Friday as market-makers covered short positions ahead of the company's full-year figures on Wednesday, expected to show a sharp rise in profits, dealers said.
Granada shares rose 9p to 892p by 1325 GMT in volume of 1.3 million shares, leaving the stock near its record high of 903p set on October 22.
Analysts are forecasting pre-tax profits in a range of 451 million stg to 468 million for the year to September 30, against 351.3 million stg a year ago.
